usedFor: ThriveCart holds sales and subscriptions, and Google Docs keeps a running log through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Product Is Purchased” in ThriveCart, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each sale adds a line to one document, giving you a plain record without opening the cart.

watchOut: Choose add, not replace, in “Add or Replace Text In Tab”, or each new sale wipes the last one.
